content.short: Covalent provides a unified blockchain data API for querying token balances, NFTs, transactions, and DeFi data across dozens of networks including Mantle.
content.description: Covalent is a unified blockchain data API platform providing structured access to on-chain data across dozens of networks through a single, consistent API interface, enabling developers to query token balances, NFT metadata, transaction histories, and DeFi protocol data without building complex indexing infrastructure. Supporting Mantle Network, Covalent is widely used for portfolio trackers, analytics dashboards, and financial applications requiring normalized multi-chain data.
content.meta: Covalent provides a unified API for querying on-chain data across blockchains including Mantle. Discover Covalent on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
